product_overview: Neon Path Puzzle is a web-based neon-themed one-stroke logic puzzle where players draw a continuous path to visit every node exactly once. The game offers 200 handcrafted levels, unlockable achievements, theme customization, and local progress saved in the browser.
core_goals: Provide a polished, responsive web experience for drawing-based puzzle gameplay across desktop and touch devices
Expose a clear progression of 200 levels with local progress tracking and level locking
Offer strategic assists via hints and power-ups while preserving challenge through limited lives
Enable player expression through multiple neon themes and an achievements system
Keep the client lightweight and offline-capable with localStorage fallback for progress

features.name: Level Selection & Progress
features.description: Browse and launch any unlocked level from the landing screen, view lock and completion state, and persist per-user progress locally in the browser.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View animated landing screen with neon theme and particle background -> Browse grid of level cards with lock and completion indicators -> Click a level card to start playing that level -> Navigate to /play/:id -> See game canvas and level header -> Return to / -> See updated completion status on the level card

Navigate to / -> View animated landing screen with neon theme and particle background -> Browse grid of level cards with lock and completion indicators -> Click a locked level card -> See locked indicator and tooltip -> Level does not open

Navigate to / -> Click an unlocked level card to start playing -> Navigate to /play/:id -> Complete level -> Progress saved to localStorage -> Clear browser storage manually -> Navigate to / -> See level card shows incomplete (progress lost)

features.name: Core Puzzle Gameplay
features.description: Play Neon Path puzzles on the game canvas: draw a continuous non-crossing path visiting each node once, manage lives, use hints and power-ups, and complete or replay levels.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Click a level card to start playing that level -> Navigate to /play/:id -> See game canvas and header with lives -> Draw a path on the game canvas to solve the puzzle visiting all nodes exactly once -> See level complete modal or success state -> Click Next Level -> Navigate to /play/:next_id

Navigate to / -> Click a level card to start playing that level -> Navigate to /play/:id -> Draw a path on the game canvas and make an invalid backtrack -> Lose one life -> See lives decrement in header -> Continue playing

Navigate to / -> Click a level card to start playing that level -> Navigate to /play/:id -> Draw a path on the game canvas and make repeated invalid moves until lives reach 0 -> See Game Over screen -> Click Replay -> Restart level on /play/:id
Navigate to /play/:id -> Click Hint button -> See a suggested path segment rendered on the game canvas -> Follow the suggested path segment to continue solving the level
Navigate to /play/:id -> Activate Undo Shield power-up -> Make a backtrack on the game canvas -> Observe Undo Shield prevents life loss -> See Undo Shield consumed

features.name: Achievements & Themes
features.description: View and track unlockable achievements and customize the game's neon visuals using the theme selector with immediate visual updates.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Open achievements tab -> See list of unlocked and upcoming achievements with progress indicators -> Click a listed achievement to view details

Navigate to / -> Open theme selector -> Change the active neon theme by selecting a theme option -> Observe animated particle and glow effects update with new theme colors -> Start a level and see theme applied in-game

Navigate to / -> Open theme selector -> Change the active neon theme -> Simulate localStorage write failure or clear storage -> Refresh the page -> Observe theme reverts to default (theme not persisted)

tech_stack.other: Vite, TanStack Query, Wouter, Framer Motion

known_limitations.issue: All game progress and hints are stored in localStorage or in-memory fallback only.
known_limitations.impact: Progress does not sync across devices or browsers and can be lost on storage clearing.

known_limitations.issue: API route configuration imported from shared routes is used only as keys for React Query.
known_limitations.impact: There is no real backend API; network failures and server-side validation cannot be tested.
